log_retention: Initial accuracy server logs were superseded by the first timing run. Raw accuracy replies, stop reasons, per-request timings and settings were retained. Logs now explicitly identify the final timing phase. The runner was updated to use separate filenames for future runs.
model_runs: Five complete 10-case text runs, three complete 4-case image runs, and eight independent timing runs (one first request and two warm repeats each).
mobile_scope: No physical Android phone available. Emulator measurements are not handset performance.
